title: Panel Discussion: White Rabbit, Open Mind: The Story of Psychedelics
description: A special Cortex Club panel on the science, mechanisms and therapeutic potential of psychedelics, bringing together neural circuit neuroscience, psychopharmacology and clinical psychiatry. Panellists: Prof. Michael Browning (Computational Psychiatry, Oxford), Prof. Trevor Sharp (Neuropharmacology, Oxford) and Prof. Alex Kwan (Biomedical Engineering, Cornell), moderated by Prof. Abhishek Banerjee (QMUL and Oxford). Accessible to a broad audience, with time for questions and open debate. Seminar Room, Department of Pharmacology, 15:00. Earlier that day: Prof. Alex Kwan's talk, Psychedelic drug action: cell types and circuits, David Smith Lecture Theatre, 12:00.
speaker: Panel: The Story of Psychedelics
topic: Browning, Sharp and Kwan, moderated by Banerjee. Dept of Pharmacology, 15:00
